contexts.text: Those who are external (in Heaven) are not so near the Lord... The Lord from Divine love... wants to have all near Him.
Therefore the nearer they are to the Lord, the more they are heirs.
The more they were elevated to the celestial things of charity and love, the more interior they were, because they were then nearer the Lord.
In the same proportion the Angels inflow more nearly or remotely.
This city is near to flee thither () = that it was allowable from the truth of faith... It is called near because truth has affinity with good.
In proportion as Spirits and Angels are in the intelligence of truth and in the affection of good, in the same proportion they are nearer the Lord.
The Angels of the Third Heaven are proximately in the Lord's life.
For the things which there happen near a man appear to the man as if they were in him. (Compare AC 4249:2.)
They wanted me to tell their relatives...
For interior things are nearer the Divine, and exterior ones are more remote thence.
The proximate clothing of the Divine Itself.
Thou shalt be near to me () = perpetual conjunction... To be near him, thus to be continually near him, is perpetual conjunction.
Those are called wise who are in the Third Heaven, thus who are nearest the Lord; but those intelligent who are in the Second Heaven, thus who are not so near the Lord.
Those who are similar as to the states of life appear to be near each other...
Their Earth is nearer the sun.
He and his neighbour near his house () = conjunction with the nearest good of truth.
Because it was near () = that it first presents itself.
Heaven and Hell are near man...
To be sanctified in them that are nigh () = in those who are conjoined with the Lord through the good of love and truth of faith from the Word.

Hence it is that the Heavens are near the Lord according to goods, and that the Hells are remote... according to evils. Hence it is evident whence it is that to be near, and to approach, in the spiritual sense, is to be conjoined. Illustrated.
Slay ye a man his brother, and a man his companion, and a man his neighbour () = a closing up as to the influx of good and truth, and of things in affinity with them. Explained.
For those who are in affinity are neighbours.
Thus they are nearer to Him. Explained.
Interior things are nearer the Divine... and exterior things are more remote...
Just as men know their kindred... In the other life there are no kindreds...
The higher Heavens, being in the good of love, are nearest the Lord as a Sun...
Hence it is that those are near each other who are in a like state...
All things are near and afar according to His presence...
As these Angels are such, they are nearest the Lord.
The Angels dwell near to the man in proportion as he is in good from truths...
That man can be more and more nearly conjoined with the Lord. Explained. DP 33, Explained. DP 33:4, Explained.
The time is at hand () = that this is necessary in order that some may be saved. Near = necessary. Explained.
I said. Come nearer...
That Sun... is the proximate sphere around Him.
The time is at hand () = such an interior state... Near = what is internal. Compare AR 9.
The reason near = more interiorly. Explained.
The Lord is nearer to Angel, Spirit, and mail in proportion as they love Him more interiorly...
What anyone longs to see is there near...
A people near to Him ()... He is called near who by these things is conjoined with the Lord.
Near is said of the goods which are in the spiritual man.
The internal things of man... in the Word are meant by things near...
Those who are near = those who are of the Church, and from the Word are in truths.
